modes.name: trunk_forward
modes.plus: Trunk shifts forward over planted feet.
modes.minus: Trunk shifts backward over planted feet.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along x

modes.name: trunk_left
modes.plus: Trunk shifts left over planted feet.
modes.minus: Trunk shifts right over planted feet.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along y

modes.name: trunk_lower
modes.plus: Trunk lowers while all six feet remain planted.
modes.minus: Trunk rises while all six feet remain planted.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along z

modes.name: trunk_roll_left
modes.plus: Trunk rolls with its left side lower and right side higher.
modes.minus: Trunk rolls with its right side lower and left side higher.

modes.name: trunk_yaw_left
modes.plus: Trunk turns left relative to planted feet.
modes.minus: Trunk turns right relative to planted feet.
modes.kept_by: moves the base most along roll

modes.name: l0_tip_forward

modes.minus: Left front tip moves backward and clears the floor.

modes.name: l0_tip_outward
modes.plus: Left front tip moves outward toward positive y and upward.
modes.minus: Left front tip retracts toward negative y and upward.

modes.name: l0_tip_up
modes.plus: Left front tip folds upward with inward retraction.
modes.minus: Left front tip extends downward toward the floor.
